sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 34 and Internal Quality Checks row 34 (E - tests/, 'If interactive/animated/responsive/themed, the judges actually click, wait, resize, or toggle - not score a still first paint.'; no extra internal annotation on this row)
task/solution/app/public/app.js:241-242 and styles.css:118 (highlight and media query)
evidence: Every interactive, time-varying and viewport promise in the brief is graded by an explicit action, not a first paint. Live updates: functional live_updates_keep_my_work (judge.toml:233-242) uses a second browser context, scrolls the thread, opens a reply box and types a draft, then waits 'without reloading, within about ten seconds' for post/reply/edit/delete and checks the draft, open box and scroll position survive. Same-account tabs: unread_and_new_messages_line (204-216) uses two Dev contexts with 10 s waits and mark-unread. Live wall: wall_added_live (84-96) keeps Sian's page open and waits for M-13 to vanish without a reload. Typing: wall_mentions_and_links Part B (79-80) types '@' and picks a suggestion; edits_and_stale_edit (169-171) holds an edit box open in a second context. Keyboard: polish enter_sends (Shift+Enter then Enter) and escape_closes (Escape on edit and reply, reload check). Dialog toggling: delete_confirm (decline, reload, confirm). Time waits: link_highlight (still highlighted ~10 s later) and refusal_in_place (wait ~10 s untouched). Timers: timer_changes clicks the timer control and checks immediate deletion. Viewport: polish transcript_print sets 390x844 and measures documentElement.scrollWidth; visual prompt.md:49 tells the judge to resize to 1440x900 then 390x844 for phone_chambers. app_context.md:24 shows how to open the second context, so the multi-context steps can be carried out. The brief requires no theming or animation. Risk is true because: (1) the raw-evidence index says no full configured judge run of these bytes exists, so nobody has measured whether the glm judge actually performs the waits, contexts and resizes; (2) side notes for other rows: link_highlight requires the highlight to persist ~10 s, but the brief only says 'highlights it, so you can spot it at once' (conversations.md, Links to messages), so a conforming 2 s flash highlight would fail; and the brief's 'no sideways scrolling at 390 px' is measured with scrollWidth only on the transcript, while the thread at 390 px is scored only by the visual likert phone_chambers.
